unguardedMeaningChanges: CUE-034 is transcribed in the supplied SRT as 愉快中慢/愉繁中简/愉闹中静, while the burned subtitle and whiteboard support 于快中慢/于繁中简/于闹中静. The candidate reconstructs the intended semantics but does not register this carrier conflict, so it silently normalizes a consequential SRT ambiguity.

CUE-068 begins by reasserting that the viewer cannot fail to understand. probe.json notices this, but article.md and the final knowledge units reduce the closing to class dismissal, self-tagline, and farewell; the final guarantee is therefore not preserved as a reconstructed meaning change.
unguardedRelationships: The relationship between the evidence pack's 16 scene-detection segments and the visibly continuous fixed whiteboard setup is not concluded or bounded. Without this relation, a downstream reader could still mistake motion-triggered segments for 16 distinct scenes.

The final relations array uses self-edges for decomposition, realization, conditions, causation, and presenter-role relations (KU-06->KU-06, KU-07->KU-07, KU-13->KU-13, KU-14->KU-14, KU-30->KU-30), weakening the structured claim-evidence graph even though the prose is intelligible.
metaAudit.rationale: The candidate's own metaGate says no carrier, meaning change, or relationship was overlooked, but the final package leaves the CUE-034 transcript conflict unguarded, loses part of CUE-068, and fails to close the scene-segmentation-versus-continuity relation. examples.result: 67 of 68 cues are semantically preserved in the final reconstruction; CUE-068 is only partially preserved. All 68 cues have bookkeeping rows, so row presence must not be mistaken for semantic completeness.
The four conditions, three mechanisms, empathy hierarchy, self/world branch, form split, and hotspot boundary are all captured; the board materially improves reconstruction beyond the SRT.

The independent audit says the closing self-description is 人类最善变的, but the candidate's targeted frame ACT-CLOSING-REFERENT-AND-CTA-SCOPE-006 visibly reads 我是人类最强编导. This is an audit discrepancy, not an unsupported candidate claim.

The five numeric judge fields are schema-required placeholders at the minimum value. No substantive JUDGE evaluation was performed because the meta-gate failed, and these values must not be interpreted as quality scores.
